milestone: G2-D architecture selection and identity foundation

architecture_decision.status: RECOMMENDATION, NOT APPROVED AND NOT INTEGRATED
architecture_decision.recommended_option: A - Signal protocol via org.signal:libsignal-android (X3DH/PQXDH initial agreement + Double Ratchet)
architecture_decision.option_b_noise: not selectable on current evidence: no maintained JVM implementation publishes an artifact; one candidate self-declares as unaudited; Noise stops at the handshake and would require a self-written ratchet
architecture_decision.option_c_other: MLS (RFC 9420) is a group protocol with a delivery-service assumption; Tink 1.24.0 is primitives only and composes to a custom protocol; neither improves on A for a 1:1 serverless BLE messenger
blocking_gates: D2-a: build the AAR at a pinned version with Java 21 + core library desugaring on the owner's Windows machine
D2-b: install on SM-G610F (API 27, 32-bit) and one API 31+ device and self-check JNI load, key generation, sign and verify
D2-c: pin artifact version and SHA-256, enumerate transitive dependencies and licenses
D1: choose X3DH vs PQXDH for v1 and the bundle framing on G2-C

tink.role: primitives and storage encryption only, not a session protocol

android_keystore.source: Android Keystore documentation plus the platform key algorithm set; to be probed per device

capabilities: strict identity record codec with version, enum, fingerprint and consistency validation
lifecycle: create, beginRotation, completeRotation, revoke, resetRevokedIdentity
typed failure results; no exceptions for expected failure paths
storage contract with atomicity, no-fallback and no-repair requirements
fail-closed default store (G2dUnavailableIdentityStore): nothing is persisted without a verified adapter
test double with write-failure, non-atomic-write and corruption injection
key protection requires a probe result before it can be recorded or parsed
seven-axis peer trust model with mandatory ordering and terminal revocation
identity change detection that fails closed and requires a fresh ceremony
honest status labels that never say secure/encrypted/trusted

any UI for identity or trust
